Name: Mega Greenhouse Orchard
Author: den2nova
Description:
[b]📖 Description
[/b]
This mod adds a lush, greenhouse-style building dedicated to fruit tree cultivation. It offers a massive space where you can grow up to [b]336 fruit trees[/b] year-round. The open area within the building can be freely decorated to your liking.
(An optional version is available that converts the free space into a tillable field area.)

In the config file, you can choose interior color schemes compatible with popular visual styles such as [b]Vanilla, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]VPR[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]Earthy[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15049]Elegant[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic[/url][/b], [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue[/url][/b].(Defaults to 'Vanilla'.)
Enjoy growing a wide variety of fruit trees added by other mods without worrying about space limitations!

The orchard can be constructed by [b]Robin[/b], and it is built [b]separately from the standard greenhouse[/b]. It can even be built [b]before unlocking the vanilla greenhouse[/b], allowing for early fruit tree cultivation. (If you prefer to delay access, simply install this mod after unlocking the greenhouse.)

There are also 4 exit-only paths within the building in addition to the main front entrance, making it easy to leave the orchard from multiple spots.

This is my first ever map edit mod — I hope you enjoy it!

[line][b]
🛠️ Installation
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and extract the ZIP file.
[*]Move the [CP] Mega Greenhouse Orchard folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.

[/list][line][b]
🙏 Credits & Thanks[/b]

This mod was created by modifying the original [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32098]Indoor Orchard[/url][/b] by [b]Syanide23[/b]. Special thanks to Syanide23 for kindly granting permission to edit and release this version.

The interior tilesheets used in this mod were incorporated with permission from:
[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28530]Green Coops and Barns[/url]﻿[/b] by [b]vikich3rry[/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8460]Better Critters[/url]﻿[/b] by [b]TurmionKala[/b]
[/list]We deeply appreciate their wonderful contributions to the Stardew Valley modding community.


[line]
[b]❓ Q&A[/b]

[b]Q. Can you make this mod compatible with a specific recolor mod?[/b]
A. Feel free to leave a request in the POSTS section — I’d be happy to hear your suggestions!

[b]Q. The soil and grass still look like vanilla. Why?[/b]
A. To match your favorite recolor mod, copy the files [b]spring_outdoorsTileSheet.png[/b] and [b]spring_Waterfalls.png[/b] from that mod’s assets folder into the [b][CP] Mega Greenhouse Orchard/assets[/b] folder.

[b]Q. I found a bug or mistake.[/b]
A. This is my first time editing a map, so there may be some issues I missed. Please report any bugs in the POSTS section. If you also know how to fix the problem, I’d really appreciate it if you could share the solution along with your report!

[b]Q. Can I change the exterior appearance of the building?[/b]
[b]A.[/b] There are no official options yet, but you can customize it yourself by editing an existing [b]Alternative Textures[/b] mod.
Detailed instructions are included in the [b]Articles[/b] section of this page — please check there if you're interested!
